units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	The creature approaches you on all six limbs, but stands up on its hind two legs once it is only a few paces away from you. It is rather small, hardly reaching your chin while it stands at full height, with big round eyes and a large, bulbous nose. It extends its four arms outward, revealing the palms of its hands. Except for its face and palms, it is covered in a thin layer of golden brown fur. It begins speaking. You can't understand what it's saying, but it seems to be cycling through various different languages and pausing after each line, as each sentence sounds wildly different from the last. You're suddenly startled when it says perfectly, "Hello."|92|0
units.english: The creature approaches you on all six limbs, but stands up on its hind two legs once it is only a few paces away from you. It is rather small, hardly reaching your chin while it stands at full height, with big round eyes and a large, bulbous nose. It extends its four arms outward, revealing the palms of its hands. Except for its face and palms, it is covered in a thin layer of golden brown fur. It begins speaking. You can't understand what it's saying, but it seems to be cycling through various different languages and pausing after each line, as each sentence sounds wildly different from the last. You're suddenly startled when it says perfectly, "Hello."
units.italian: La creatura ti si avvicina su tutte e sei le zampe, ma si alza sulle due posteriori quando è a pochi passi da te. È piuttosto piccola: a tutta altezza le arriva a malapena al mento, con grandi occhi rotondi e un naso grosso e bulboso. Allunga le quattro braccia, mostrando i palmi delle mani. A parte il viso e i palmi, è coperta da un sottile strato di pelliccia bruno dorata. Comincia a parlare. Non capisci cosa dica, ma sembra passare in rassegna varie lingue diverse e fare una pausa dopo ogni frase, perché ogni frase suona completamente diversa dalla precedente. Sussulti quando dice perfettamente: "Salve."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Hello?"|94|0
units.english: "Hello?"
units.italian: "Salve?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Wait, say that again."|95|0
units.english: "Wait, say that again."
units.italian: "Aspetta, ripetilo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Hello," the creature repeats itself. "Hello. Hello. Hello," it continues to say.|97|0
units.english: "Hello," the creature repeats itself. "Hello. Hello. Hello," it continues to say.
units.italian: "Salve," ripete la creatura. "Salve. Salve. Salve," continua a dire.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Can you say anything else?"|99|0
units.english: "Can you say anything else?"
units.italian: "Sai dire qualcos'altro?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"How do you know my language?"|100|0
units.english: "How do you know my language?"
units.italian: "Come fai a conoscere la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Hello."|102|0
units.english: "Hello."
units.italian: "Salve."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Can you say anything else?" it repeats back to you.|104|0
units.english: "Can you say anything else?" it repeats back to you.
units.italian: "Sai dire qualcos'altro?" ti ripete.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"How do you know my language?" it repeats back to you.|107|0
units.english: "How do you know my language?" it repeats back to you.
units.italian: "Come fai a conoscere la mia lingua?" ti ripete.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Human?" it asks.|109|0
units.english: "Human?" it asks.
units.italian: "Umano?" chiede.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Yes, I am a human."|111|0
units.english: "Yes, I am a human."
units.italian: "Sì, sono un umano."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"What even are you?"|112|0
units.english: "What even are you?"
units.italian: "Ma tu cosa sei?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Human," it says to itself confidently. "Human. Human. Human," it repeats, looking around as if it is searching for something in its mind. "One... hundred years ago. Human," it says.|113|0
units.english: "Human," it says to itself confidently. "Human. Human. Human," it repeats, looking around as if it is searching for something in its mind. "One... hundred years ago. Human," it says.
units.italian: "Umano," si dice con sicurezza. "Umano. Umano. Umano," ripete, guardandosi intorno come se cercasse qualcosa nella propria mente. "Cento... anni fa. Umano," dice.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I'm not the first human here?"|115|0
units.english: "I'm not the first human here?"
units.italian: "Non sono il primo umano a venire qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"What do you mean one hundred years ago?"|116|0
units.english: "What do you mean one hundred years ago?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuoi dire con cento anni fa?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Human visitors, many years ago," it says. "Not important. The Queen desires your presence." It then says something in a language that the mantis-like aliens understand, and they motion for you to follow as the small alien begins making its way back to the steps of the palace. You have a feeling you're going to dread the next half hour.|117|0
units.english: "Human visitors, many years ago," it says. "Not important. The Queen desires your presence." It then says something in a language that the mantis-like aliens understand, and they motion for you to follow as the small alien begins making its way back to the steps of the palace. You have a feeling you're going to dread the next half hour.
units.italian: "Visitatori umani, molti anni fa," dice. "Non importante. La Regina desidera la tua presenza." Poi dice qualcosa in una lingua che gli alieni simili a mantidi capiscono, e loro ti fanno cenno di seguirli mentre il piccolo alieno si incammina verso i gradini del palazzo. Hai la sensazione che la prossima mezz'ora sarà un calvario.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	You finally reach the top of the palace stairs completely exhausted, although the aliens with you look entirely unphased.|118|0
units.english: You finally reach the top of the palace stairs completely exhausted, although the aliens with you look entirely unphased.
units.italian: Finalmente arrivi in cima alle scale del palazzo completamente esausto, anche se gli alieni che ti accompagnano sembrano del tutto imperturbabili.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	The aliens lead you into the palace and through various elegant hallways. The walls are lined with marble statues and paintings that seem to be depicting historical figures and events for this alien race, although you're not allowed to linger long enough to get a good look at any of them.|119|0
units.english: The aliens lead you into the palace and through various elegant hallways. The walls are lined with marble statues and paintings that seem to be depicting historical figures and events for this alien race, although you're not allowed to linger long enough to get a good look at any of them.
units.italian: Gli alieni ti conducono dentro il palazzo e attraverso vari corridoi eleganti. Le pareti sono rivestite di statue di marmo e dipinti che sembrano raffigurare personaggi ed eventi storici di questa razza aliena, anche se non ti è permesso fermarti abbastanza da guardarli bene.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	You eventually approach a large ornate doorway that the aliens push open, revealing what must be the Queen's throne room. It is a long, narrow room lined with stained glass windows with what you guess is a throne chair where the alien Queen sits. The Queen is part of the mantis-like species and considerably larger in appearance than the ones guarding you.|120|0
units.english: You eventually approach a large ornate doorway that the aliens push open, revealing what must be the Queen's throne room. It is a long, narrow room lined with stained glass windows with what you guess is a throne chair where the alien Queen sits. The Queen is part of the mantis-like species and considerably larger in appearance than the ones guarding you.
units.italian: Alla fine ti avvicini a una grande porta ornata che gli alieni spingono, rivelando quella che dev'essere la sala del trono della Regina. È una stanza lunga e stretta, rivestita di vetrate istoriate, con quella che supponi essere la sedia del trono dove siede la Regina aliena. La Regina appartiene alla specie simile alle mantidi ed è considerevolmente più grande di quelle che ti fanno da guardia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	The small creature says something to the Queen as you approach, and the Queen responds. The creature turns to you to translate.|121|0
units.english: The small creature says something to the Queen as you approach, and the Queen responds. The creature turns to you to translate.
units.italian: La piccola creatura dice qualcosa alla Regina mentre ti avvicini, e la Regina risponde. La creatura si gira verso di te per tradurre.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I hear that you have attacked one of my Megasa."|128|0
units.english: "I hear that you have attacked one of my Megasa."
units.italian: "Sento che hai attaccato uno dei miei Megasa."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Your what?"|130|0
units.english: "Your what?"
units.italian: "Uno dei tuoi cosa?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I was only defending myself."|132|0
units.english: "I was only defending myself."
units.italian: "Mi stavo solo difendendo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I have, and for that I apologize."|134|0
units.english: "I have, and for that I apologize."
units.italian: "È vero, e per questo mi scuso."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Okay, and?"|136|0
units.english: "Okay, and?"
units.italian: "Va bene, e allora?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I hear that you have attacked one of my civilians."|140|0
units.english: "I hear that you have attacked one of my civilians."
units.italian: "Sento che hai attaccato uno dei miei civili."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I was only defending myself."|142|0
units.english: "I was only defending myself."
units.italian: "Mi stavo solo difendendo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I have, and for that I apologize."|144|0
units.english: "I have, and for that I apologize."
units.italian: "È vero, e per questo mi scuso."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Okay, and?"|146|0
units.english: "Okay, and?"
units.italian: "Va bene, e allora?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"I hear that you have fought a member of my guard."|150|0
units.english: "I hear that you have fought a member of my guard."
units.italian: "Sento che hai combattuto contro un membro della mia guardia."
